recommend: none: parked STUCK by the agreed hard stop (recovery lemma not proved in the tight stage). If ever reopened: a unit rule for the C-meets-v event in the head, then a head invariant (real word = shadow plus a head) and a bound of 3 on the eats the head survives.
mechanism: The machine alternates two exact sweeps (A-sweep law, unit phase table). Rounds on {z,o,s,t} words are CASCADE. The eat is a closed unit rule (EATU): levels W_1 = inc(W), W = Y s^(j+1) o^k -> inc^(j+1)(Y), stop at Y z o^k; then P = cascade(reread(Y) o), delta = units removed. A potential Hub never grows under CASCADE, so the t's of P clear after 2^h - 2 rounds with h <= Hub(P) <= G(W) (digits below W's top spacer). Generic eat words (first unit a digit) have G <= D-1, so every epoch from them is t-free at the next eat; leading-spacer words have G = D, one short.

model.a_sweep: A from a turn: out[p] = [x[p]=0 and x[p+1]=1] up to the first 00; there 00 -> 01 and D reads the cell to its left
model.phase_table: B: s->101 B, o->111 B, z->100 turn, t->100 C; C: s->111 C, t->110 C, o->110 turn, z->010 turn; D: s->001 B, o->011 D, z->111 E(left), t->HALT; E: t->111 E, s->011 / o->101 / z->001 turn (scripts/deepen/phase_table.json, all 8 units x 5 entry states)
model.eat: W' = inc(W) = Y x o^k; o^k -> u^k; x=s: new marker t, Y's trailing s are its bell (mini-eat, recurse on inc(Y)); x=z: E turns one unit left; x=t: halt; finally the marker is reborn at the right end and the grid shifts by one cell
model.eat_law: t-free W, c>=2: K(W,0,c) -> clean K(P, c+delta(W), 1), with P and delta in [0,13] independent of c
model.counter: epoch eat: value(W) = c+1 (o=1, z=0, s skipped), D(W) = bitlen(c+1); post-eat: value(P) = 2 (s, t skipped); ROUND keeps value - c fixed

closed_gaps: The eat is ruled: the A-sweep law (3,000/3,000) and the unit phase table (3,000/3,000 compositions vs the TM) give it as a recursive unit-rewrite process.

Eat safety: every t-free word eats without halting, and the result does not depend on c. Exhaustive to 12 units (354,293 words; 39,365 at c = 2/12/30, identical outputs); random 13..45 units 1,500/1,500.
Halting mechanism: only a bounce with t o^k to its left can halt (the D phase meeting t).
Counter invariant: value(W) = c+1 at all 529 eats and value(P) = 2 at all 529 post-eat K-moments to 1e10.
Cryptid check: the eat does not use the counter's bits. Only the epoch's size margin does, and that is an inequality, not a pseudo-random rule. Not flagged.
remaining_gaps: Size invariant, not proven: every t created by an eat clears before the next eat. Observed on all 529 real epochs with t-lifetime (k0+1)/N <= 0.286 (<= 0.124 for N >= 1000). It is needed: forced early eats halt 173/7,830.
The rounds whose carry enters a t segment, including their internal bounces (304 of 529 epochs), have no unit-level rule, and there is no formula for k0(P).

The reachable language. Random counter-consistent starts still carry t units at the second eat in 5/3,300 cases and at the third eat in 3/3,300 (all with a tiny bell, none halting); by the fourth eat all are clean. So the invariant needs the reachable spacer structure or a bell-size margin, not only value(W) = c+1.
No epoch model past 1e10 (only 529 epochs); sibling R2 used one to reach N = 1e7.

model.cascade: carry enters at the bottom in phase B: o->z continue, s pass, z->o STOP, t->s and C run above; C run = maximal {s,t} run, s->z, t stays; TURN unit above it z->s (0^inf counts as z; turn on o outside the rule); then: empty run -> B continues above the turn unit; run's lowest unit was s -> it becomes o, STOP; it was t -> that t is entered from below (t->s, new C run on the converted units)
model.t_lifetime: k0 + 2 = 2^h, h = digit positions below the top t when the carry enters it; t's clear before the next eat iff h <= bitlen(N_new+1)-1
model.bound_hub: h <= Hub(P) = #{s,z strictly between top and lowest t} + #{z,o below the lowest t} (not tight)

model.eatu: t-free W: W_1 = inc(W); W_i = Y x o^k; x = z: stop; x = s: Y = Y0 s^j, W_(i+1) = inc^(j+1)(Y0); then X = reread(Y) o (o->s, z->z, s->t), P = cascade(X), b' = c + delta, delta = units removed by the levels
model.hub_lemma: on {z,o,s,t} words with no o above the lowest t: a CASCADE round keeps that invariant, never turns on o, adds 1 to the value, creates no t, never raises Hub = #{s,z between top and lowest t} + #{z,o below lowest t}; the round removing the top t leaves value 2^m, m <= Hub
model.generic_chain: h <= Hub(P) <= Hub(X) <= G(Y)+1 <= G(W_final) <= G(W) <= D(W)-1 for generic W (first unit a digit); so k0 = 2^h - 2 <= c-1 < b'
model.halting_in_transients: eat: the level recursion reaches a surviving t (D meets t); rounds: the B carry reaches v = 110 (Bv -> D reads 1), directly or after an empty C run; a C run reaching v through s's is safe (Cv = 011 L F)

model.equality_cases: a t survives the epoch of a leading-spacer eat word W = s^a M only if W ends in o, the eat has a single level (W_final = inc(W)) and delta = 0, Y = inc(W) minus its last z has no o below its lowest spacer, and Hub never drops in the epoch
model.tf: Y = s^a Z, Z = g_0 s^e1 g_1 ... s^em g_m (digit groups g_i, value o_i, length L_i): W is a tight failure iff W ends in o, m >= 1, g_m in z*, value(W) <= 2^D - 2 and o_i + N_i = 0 mod 2^L_i for i = m-1..0, with N_(m-1) = e_m, N_i = e_(i+1) + C_(i+1), C_i = (o_i + N_i)/2^L_i. Reason: entering a t is one old increment of the groups above the lowest t-run; exposing a group keeps Hub iff its last increment rolls it over from all ones
model.t1: the next eat word after a tight failure is bin(C_0) t^a inc(W)[a:] (bin in s = 1, z = 0)
model.next_eat: N0: value(inc(W)[a:]) is even, so the eat's first round stays in the body; N1: at most two levels (g_m nonempty: stop at once, delta 1; g_m empty: e_m mini-rounds roll g_(m-1) to all z by TF, stop at level 2, delta e_m + 1); the levels never reach the block; mini-round overflow into the block is a CASCADE round on an I-word
model.first_contact_with_v: in epoch 2 the groups below the new v replay the TF arithmetic (top group mod 2^(L_0 - 1)), so every exposure is a full rollover, no C run is empty, and the first unit to reach v is a C run (Cv: v -> u, then F), never the B carry
model.shadow: observed: the body of each surviving word equals the body of the t-free shadow S_k = s^(a_k) B_k run through the same epochs; the head rides on top
